official_definition: Exchange: Striker Pack - When your "Strike Gundam"-named Spirit attacks/blocks, this card in your Hand can change places in refreshed position with it. "Exchange" can only be used once per turn.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Exchange] or [Exchange: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Exchange]", "give [Exchange]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
